svg.title: Inside AssignTrays()
svg.desc: For every event in topological order: apply non-tray transitions, fill a missing tray id, fill a missing destination, or find the critical path and resolve blocking trays with two fallbacks.
svg.metadata: ["Start of AssignTrays(): a TrayAssignmentState holds a copy of the initial state (working_state) and an empty occupancy_history. The loop visits the events in topological order: e0, e1, e2, ...", "e0 is a BayTransition (TO_RETRIEVE on B21), not a TrayMove. ApplyBayOrChargerTransition() registers its pose in occupancy_history, applies it to working_state and the loop continues.", "e1 moves T21 out of bay B21 but has no destination. AssignDestinationAndUnblockingMoves() runs ResolveBlockingTrays(T21): OpenSpaceSearch finds parking spot P23 in tier 1, then the loop continues.", "e2 (T17: P17 -> B21) has a tray id and a destination. B21 is free in working_state because e1 already ran (ResolveDestinationHeading checks it). BlockingTraySearch walks the critical path P17 -> P15 -> W13 -> ... -> B21 and finds T15 on P15.", "Blocking loop, first pass: ResolveBlockingTrays(T15) with T17 immobile and the critical path banned finds P19 for T15.", "The blocker move is emitted as a new event e4 (T15: P15 -> P19) with the edge e4 -> e2, plus edges from occupancy_history (OrderAfterPriorOccupants) for every pose on e4's path.", "Recompute the blocking trays on the remaining path: none are left, so the while loop ends.", "Finish e2: OrderAfterPriorOccupants for the destination and source (e1 -> e2, e0 -> e2), ApplyTo(e2) on working_state, then ChainTrayEvent records last_event_by_tray / first_event_by_tray for T17.", "What if ResolveBlockingTrays had found no spot for T15? Fallback 1 advances T17 one step along its critical path and resolves again; fallback 2 retries without the critical-path ban, else it errors.", "A later event e5 that asks for 'any empty tray' has no tray id. AssignEmptyTrayToMove() runs EmptyTraySearch from the destination (time + 30 s per blocker), then continues at 'has destination?'.", "After the last event the loop ends. Every TrayMove now has a tray id and a destination; RemoveRedundantEdges() is deliberately not called here."]
